stem:
Kian records two runs on a straight path. Run P covers 100 m in 10 s. Run Q covers 120 m in 20 s.

Which claim correctly compares how fast they are?

options.text: Run P is faster because 10 m each second is greater than 6 m each second.
Run Q is faster because 120 m is farther than 100 m.
Run Q is faster because 6 m each second is greater than 10 m each second.
The runs cannot be compared because the times are different.

teacher.key_rationale: Faster means greater distance per unit time. P is 10 m/s and Q is 6 m/s, so P is faster. Comparing raw distance alone, reversing the rate order, or refusing unequal-time cases are wrong.
